rules.title: Mandate
rules.interpretation: Trade a configurable ETF wheel, default SPY. Changing the entry symbol preserves management of existing contracts and shares under their original identity. The investor is willing to own the selected ETF and wants recurrent eligible wheel exposure. Optional event uncertainty is disclosed; the trader obtains contract and premium evidence rather than requiring it from the researcher.

rules.title: Ownership
rules.interpretation: One nontrading researcher supplies compact dated evidence. Exactly one trading and risk agent selects contracts, quantities, prices and every order. Python only wires the shared attention runtime.

rules.title: Coverage
rules.interpretation: Use the configured max_contracts and max_collateral_pct (defaults one short option and 90 percent of equity). Puts remain fully cash secured including costs; calls require enough unencumbered deliverable shares. No borrowing, naked options, automatic rolls or disposal of unrelated holdings.

rules.title: Contracts
rules.interpretation: Use the configured min_dte, max_dte and target_delta (defaults 30 to 45 days and absolute delta near 0.25). Prefer covered-call strikes at or above verified share acquisition cost. Hold when no suitable listed contract exists.

rules.title: Management
rules.interpretation: Accept expiry and assignment. Persist a favorable review trigger at the configured profit_capture_pct (default 90 percent) of actual entry premium after costs, even while it is not met; a weekly review alone does not cover that target. The trigger requests a fresh trader decision about buying to close, not an automatic order. Manage residual orders and exposure before another entry.

rules.title: Attention
rules.interpretation: Plan once at startup, then observe cheaply each minute through the closing observation. Schedule entries entry_minutes_before_close before the actual exchange session close (default 15 minutes, including known shortened sessions). Use the configured calendar or a reasonable disclosed approximation when exact metadata is unavailable; do not make missing metadata another mandatory entry condition. Startup planning does not authorize an early entry. A planned entry can reuse still-current planning research via management scope. With no short wheel option or related working option order, preserve one entry opportunity per eligible session, whether cash can secure a put or shares can cover a call. While an option or order occupies that capacity, remove obsolete daily setup timers; do not schedule daily setup/research merely because another session opens. Persist meaningful profit, quantity, order, expiry and thesis conditions plus one recurring management review within holding_review_days (default seven calendar days). Reconcile assignment, call-away, closing and terminal orders as management first, then preserve the next eligible setup if capacity is free. Clean obsolete watches before saving an updated future review; never delete its newly updated definition. A watch reason is explanatory text, not another condition.

rules.title: Pricing
rules.interpretation: Use price-bounded limit orders with the configured time_in_force (DAY by default). Smart limits are not the default. Inspect exact option market evidence; disclose historical trade-bar approximation and never replace it with future or current quotes.
